players.note: McLaughlin turned five kickoff returns into 117 yards during the Browns' 27-24 win over the Titans on Sunday.

players.name: Jordan James
players.note: James logged a six-yard carry, turned his lone target into an 11-yard catch and registered 119 yards on four kickoff returns during the 49ers' 29-20 loss to the Falcons on Sunday.

players.name: De'Zhaun Stribling
players.note: Stribling (ankle) remains on track to return in December, David Lombardi of SFStandard.com reports.

players.name: Jaylin Noel
players.note: The Texans placed Noel on injured reserve Wednesday.

players.name: Brashard Smith
players.note: The Chiefs placed Smith (hamstring) on injured reserve Saturday.

players.name: Isaiah Davis
players.note: Davis logged a five-yard carry and caught all three of his targets for 49 yards during Sunday's 28-25 loss to Miami. He also added a tackle on special teams.

players.name: Kaleb Johnson
players.note: Johnson (coach's decision) is inactive for Sunday's game against the Lions.

players.name: Jack Bech
players.note: The Raiders designated Bech (forearm) for return from injured reserve Monday.

players.name: Kendre Miller
players.note: Miller rushed eight times for six yards in Sunday's 16-10 loss to the Steelers in Paris.

players.name: Kaytron Allen
players.note: Allen logged six snaps on special teams and didn't show up on the box score otherwise during Sunday's 28-25 win over the Jets.

players.name: DJ Giddens
players.note: Giddens did not play a single snap during Sunday's 13-10 loss to the Vikings.

players.name: Bam Knight
players.note: Knight accrued seven carries for 48 yards and reeled in three of five targets for 15 yards during Sunday's 30-16 defeat to the Broncos.

players.name: Tyler Badie
players.note: The Broncos placed Badie (thumb) on injured reserve Saturday, Aric DiLalla of the team's official site reports.

players.name: James Conner
players.note: When asked Monday if Conner (foot) will play this season, coach Mike LaFleur said "potentially," Dani Sureck of the Cardinals' official site reports.

players.name: Erick All Jr.
players.note: Bengals head coach Zac Taylor confirmed Wednesday that All has been diagnosed with a torn ACL in his right knee and will require season-ending surgery, Jay Morrison of SI.com reports.

players.name: Carson Beck
players.note: questionable

players.name: Ty Simpson
players.note: Simpson (coach's decision) is inactive but will serve as the Rams' emergency third quarterback against the Raiders on Sunday, Sarah Barshop of ESPN.com reports.

players.name: Jalon Daniels
players.note: Daniels was back in his primary reserve role behind Baker Mayfield in Sunday's 43-13 win over the Panthers.

players.name: Hollywood Brown
players.note: Brown secured two of five targets for 30 yards in the Eagles' 38-21 loss to the Cowboys on Monday night.

players.name: Colbie Young
players.note: Young (knee) was not listed on the Bengals' injury report Wednesday.

players.name: Jaylin Lane
players.note: Lane underwent surgery Oct. 9 to repair his fractured and dislocated ankle, and he is expected to be cleared for activities before OTAs, Tashan Reed of The Washington Post reports.

players.name: Demarcus Robinson
players.note: 49ers coach Kyle Shanahan reiterated Monday that Robinson (ankle) has a chance to return following the team's Week 8 bye, David Lombardi of SFStandard.com reports.

players.name: Alec Ingold
players.note: The Chargers placed Ingold on injured reserve Thursday due to a shoulder injury.

players.name: Spencer Rattler
players.note: Rattler is active and will remain the Saints' No. 2 quarterback for Sunday's game against the Steelers in Paris, Ross Jackson of WWL Louisiana reports.

players.name: Tyler Huntley
players.note: Huntley completed 23 of 34 passes for 298 yards with a touchdown and an interception while adding three rushes for 12 yards in the Ravens' 35-13 loss to the Bengals on Sunday.

players.name: Jalen Brooks
players.note: The Cardinals placed Brooks (wrist) on injured reserve Tuesday.

players.name: Mason Rudolph
players.note: Rudolph is active for Sunday's game against the Saints in Paris, Teresa Varley of the Steelers' official site reports.

players.name: Elijah Moore
players.note: Moore caught both of his targets for 16 yards during Monday's 38-21 loss to the Cowboys.

players.name: Brevin Jordan
players.note: Jordan (foot) does not have any injury designation ahead of Sunday's game against the Giants, Adam Caplan of SiriusXM NFL Radio reports.

players.name: Sam Ehlinger
players.note: Ehlinger (coach's decision) is inactive but will serve as the emergency third quarterback in Sunday's game against the Cardinals, Aric DiLalla of the Broncos' official site reports.

players.name: David Sills V
players.note: Sills (hamstring) was activated from injured reserve by the Buccaneers on Thursday, Scott Smith of the team's official website reports.

players.name: Roschon Johnson
players.note: Johnson rushed twice for 13 yards in the Bears' 30-24 victory over the Patriots on Thursday.

players.name: Aidan O'Connell
players.note: O'Connell (coach's decision) is inactive but will serve as the Raiders' emergency third quarterback against the Rams on Sunday.

players.name: Tip Reiman
players.note: Head coach Mike LaFleur stated he's "not too sure" if Reiman (ankle) will play this season, Dani Sureck of the Cardinals' official site reports.

players.name: Dillon Gabriel
players.note: The Browns activated Gabriel (back) from injured reserve Monday.

players.name: Jalen Milroe
players.note: Milroe is active and operating as the Seahawks' primary backup quarterback for Sunday night's matchup with Kansas City.

players.name: Dont'e Thornton Jr.
players.note: The Raiders reinstated Thornton (hamstring) from injured reserve Tuesday.

players.name: Carter Runyon
players.note: The Raiders have ruled out Runyon (foot) for Sunday's game against the Rams.

players.name: Garrett Nussmeier
players.note: Nussmeier (coach's decision) is inactive as the emergency third quarterback for Sunday night's game against the Seahawks.

players.name: Cole Payton
players.note: Payton (coach's decision) is inactive for Monday's game against the Cowboys but will serve as the team's emergency quarterback.

players.name: Dare Ogunbowale
players.note: Ogunbowale didn't record an offensive touch or target in Sunday's 24-21 overtime loss to the Giants.

players.name: Tanner Hudson
players.note: Hudson (pectoral) was placed on injured reserve by the Bengals on Monday.

players.name: Tom Kennedy
players.note: The Lions placed Kennedy (knee) on injured reserve Friday.

players.name: Michael Carter
players.note: questionable

players.name: Elijah Mitchell
players.note: The Eagles elevated Mitchell from the practice squad ahead of Monday night's game against Dallas.

players.name: Khalil Herbert
players.note: Herbert reverted to the Falcons' practice squad Monday, per the NFL's transaction log.

players.name: Velus Jones Jr.
players.note: Jones (hamstring) has been ruled out for the remainder of Sunday night's contest against the Chiefs.

players.name: Dameon Pierce
players.note: The Eagles placed Pierce (undisclosed) on injured reserve Wednesday

players.name: Evan Hull
players.note: The Cardinals signed Hull from the practice squad to the active roster Saturday, Tyler Drake of ArizonaSports.com reports.
